overview.description: The MFS Active Short Muni Bond ETF (MFSX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The funds investment objective is to seek total return with an emphasis on income exempt from U.S. federal income tax, but also considering capital preservation. MFSX was launched on Sep 10, 2026 and is issued by MFS.
